scope: Browser and VS Code clients for native Git review patches

browser.workflow: Choose working tree, branch or committed comparison; use inferred base or enter one; select changed file and render the native patch as text in the workspace review area.
browser.workspace_binding: Uses the connected selected-workspace backend; changing workspace clears patch rows and rendered patch contents.
browser.validation: Strict per-file metadata and patch-size checks; patch is inserted with textContent, not interpreted as markup.

vscode.workflow: Select comparison, provide a review base if native inference is unavailable, select a changed file and open its backend-produced patch using VS Code diff language mode.
vscode.workspace_binding: Checks workspace trust, authenticated selected backend, native workspace ticket and view identity before and after user prompts and before display.

validation.vscode_review_tests: Provider client routing/validation and extension-host command interaction are included in the 280 tests.
validation.browser_review_tests: Mode/base selection, changed-file rendering, text-only patch output and empty-base guidance are included in the 84 tests.

limits: These DOM and extension-host tests are not rendered external-browser or installed-IDE acceptance.
VS Code opens a unified patch document, not a side-by-side original/current workspace diff.
Rename detection, binary review UX, patch application and complete OpenCode VCS parity remain incomplete.
